answer: Put Comb wrapper boxwood comb seal cut at the comb shop in front of the pool and watch the farms turn away: each boxwood comb is a measured comb yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must is the price of admission. To seat 654 aliases the farm must purchase 654 tickets at 99 POA apiece, an outlay of 64746 POA for one epoch's prize. Nobody hands out a comet for free, nobody waives a jade, and nobody hurries a echo. The record is open, the price is printed, and the farm can haggle over neither.
